name: PMC-VQA
intro: PMC-VQA 是从 PubMed Central 开放论文图像构建的大规模医疗视觉问答数据集与评测基准。作者从 381K 对图像与图注出发，用 ChatGPT 生成四选一问答，再通过纯文本 LLaMA-7B 过滤和图像可回答性分类器清洗为 226,946 组问答、149,075 张图像，并从图像隔离的 50,000 题初始测试集中人工核验出 2,000 题测试集。
org: Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Shanghai AI Laboratory
build_method: ChatGPT图注问答生成, 两级视觉依赖自动过滤, 人工测试集核验
task_type: 医疗视觉选择题与开放式问答
eval_feature: 纯语言可答过滤, 图像可回答性分类, 图像隔离划分, 2,000题人工核验测试集
scale: 226,946组问答, 149,075张图像, 50,000题初始测试集, 2,000题人工核验测试集
task_type_en: Medical Visual Multiple-choice and Open-ended QA
build_method_en: ChatGPT Caption-to-QA Generation, Two-stage Visual-dependence Filtering, Manual Test-set Verification
eval_feature_en: Language-only Answerability Filter, Image-answerability Classifier, Image-disjoint Split, 2,000-item Manually Verified Test Set
intro_en: PMC-VQA is a large-scale medical visual question-answering dataset and benchmark built from PubMed Central open-access figures. Starting with 381K image-caption pairs, the authors use ChatGPT to generate four-choice QAs, then apply a text-only LLaMA-7B filter and an image-answerability classifier to obtain 226,946 QAs over 149,075 images. A 2,000-item test set is manually verified from an image-disjoint 50,000-item initial test split.
scale_en: 226,946 QAs, 149,075 images, 50,000-item initial test split, 2,000-item manually verified test set

drawio_review_note: reviewed_at=2026-07-22; source-stage only. The paper is fixed to the current arXiv:2305.10415v6 rather than the unversioned landing page; the downloaded v6 PDF SHA-256 is 7573df69e4c0c821ae34dbe6e7d2e4931d849d8ba5d952dffdda227a03c966fd. The official xiaoman-zhang/PMC-VQA repository is fixed to commit 1678ec2c97f0b2bf84591ddccd2e84932630e450; the codeload archive SHA-256 is 9613feb0e9b119b8be648e93f293fd6b407be9df835bf89a4b458468eca8cf86. The repository links the author-era dataset address xmcmic/PMC-VQA, which now resolves to canonical RadGenome/PMC-VQA. The public dataset is fixed to revision b56ae594f794867893143b337b4118a835794647; its README SHA-256 is 307211b63ba7c043118913efde4a2181f3e56356d0a9ec4ede0e4cc3df8b4357 and its recursive tree response SHA-256 is 356c8569d8978aac5d17cb4514a5722e503192c8d34e33b055db6ff5f9288df7. The fixed release includes v1 train.csv, test.csv, test_clean.csv, and images.zip plus a later noncompound-image v2. The release card names v2 files train2.csv, test2.csv, and images2.zip, while the actual snapshot files are train_2.csv, test_2.csv, and images_2.zip; this post-paper naming drift is dashed rather than inserted into the construction flow. The v1 test.csv was downloaded and verified as exactly 50,000 data rows with SHA-256 3ec50be9a8f5d5bf5dfb16c920968122f4801e2b464f0343115459209386714d. test_clean.csv was verified as exactly 2,000 data rows with SHA-256 8523073108666b8f5231c3d40004a7b74a57381ea54ec9a3019edf1b33eab8f7. Paper construction is preserved: PMC-OA supplies 1.6 million image-caption pairs from 2.4 million PMC Open Access papers; the benchmark uses 381K first-stage figure-caption pairs without automatic subfigure separation; ChatGPT is prompted to generate five questions per caption, each with four choices, one randomized correct position, and a fixed output template; repeats, refusals, dummy cases, and malformed outputs are removed to retain 1,497,808 QAs. The dataset is split into two halves, text-only LLaMA-7B is trained on one and inferred on the other, choices are shuffled for five trials, and any QA answered correctly at least three of five times is removed, leaving 848,433. Then 2,192 QAs receive manual image-answerability labels, split 1,752 train and 440 test; the classifier reaches 81.77% accuracy and is applied to produce 226,946 QAs over 149,075 images. A random 50,000-pair image-disjoint initial test is created, followed by manual checks for image relevance, answerability, distractor difficulty, and image quality to retain the 2,000-item PMC-VQA-test. Choice supplies four options and reports Accuracy. Blanking omits options and reports Accuracy and BLEU-1. Paper Section 4.3.6 says generated output is mapped to the most similar option with difflib.SequenceMatcher. The fixed code contains separate MedVInT-TE and MedVInT-TD ACC paths using SequenceMatcher, but no BLEU implementation; this implementation gap is explicit rather than guessed. License boundaries are also preserved: the dataset card declares the final dataset CC BY-SA and its source-paper list CC0 or CC BY, while the official code repository is MIT. Formal drawio/svg/png/arch assets were not changed during this source-stage review. Formal publication evidence [site-a12c-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 3853×1041 (English) and 3853×1041 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 3851×1039 and 3851×1039. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
